scope: One common pure C mip plan and typed SDK bridge replace three duplicated copy loops in each frontend. Matching dimensions skip larger source top mips; remaining available source levels cap every face and destination. Theoretical matching shapes with absent source mip storage succeed without copying as an explicit safe proxy policy. All copied metadata is validated before destination shadows are allocated; all required shadows are prepared before copying/emitting, and late invalid metadata/OOM cannot produce a pixel-copy prefix. Allocations already prepared can remain reusable. Upload transport errors retain an accepted prefix. D3D9 shadow validity is set for all texture kinds; lazy render-target mirrors are allocated. Existing owner/type/format and D3D9 pool guards remain. Existing D3D8 permissive pool behavior, dirty-region semantics and locked copied levels are not a complete UpdateTexture contract audit. The XP probe uses seven valid creation scenes per API: 2D full/short chains, cube full/short chains with differing source/destination mip strides, volume and depth-dominant slices, and a single-level render-target destination supported by both current constructors. All source/initializer writes use SYSTEMMEM and initial sentinel UpdateTexture, never DEFAULT locking. Known uniform colors yield 84 frames and 252 probes on each GPU. No original Microsoft HAL pixels or unsafe mismatched-memory copies are claimed. Host code and bundle remain unchanged, inheriting the linked prior full GPU/533-case baseline plus this new fixture. Guest wrappers, programmable CPU processing and remaining stages 4/5/6 continue.
